summary: Sony's PlayStation Home was a PlayStation 3 social virtual world and storefront/service platform, now shut down officially and preserved only through documentation, cached assets, and community revival work.

entries.title: PlayStation Home
entries.definitive_edition: Destination Home preservation route for interaction; original PS3 service captures/cache for historical fidelity

emulation.notes: Original PS3 hardware or RPCS3 can be used with Destination Home; official Sony service cannot be replayed normally.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Community restoration with original cache/asset provenance documented

primary.version: Original service documentation plus Destination Home revival, clearly labeled
primary.why: The official PlayStation Home service shut down worldwide in 2015, so a normal official playthrough is impossible. Archive work should document original PS3-era footage/assets where available and use Destination Home only as a community preservation/revival route, not an official replacement.
primary.how_to_play: If documenting interactively, use Destination Home on supported PS3 hardware or RPCS3 per the preservation project's instructions. Record original account/cache provenance if available, client/build, restored space, online/offline state, avatar/items, emulator/console setup, and that it is not the official Sony service.

secondary.what_to_play: Use preserved footage, screenshots, cache data, or original capture logs when available.
secondary.why: The official servers are gone, so original state cannot be replayed normally.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record shutdown status, project/build, restored-space coverage, and any missing server-era features.
